qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between safety bolts on B-pillar and safety bolts on body?
qa_pairs.answer: Safety bolts on body require 48 Nm while B-pillar safety bolts require 31 Nm, a difference of 17 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which components require the highest torque specification according to this table?
qa_pairs.answer: Safety bolt on body (except for B-pillar) and safety bolt on seat/touring rear seat backrest both require 48 Nm
